analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict: The Legal Team insists the app cannot process payments or handle money at all, while the Student Union President wants to collect a 2% transaction fee on every sale to fund club activities. You cannot collect a percentage fee without processing the transaction on-platform.

Proposed Resolution: Keep peer-to-peer transactions entirely off-platform (cash or external Venmo) to satisfy the Legal Team. To fund club activities, pivot the monetization model away from transaction fees. Instead, implement a small flat fee for "Featured/Boosted Listings" or charge a minimal semester-based subscription fee for high-volume student sellers.
